issues.title: Add ZIP code column to the sync status widget
issues.body:
## Goal
Show the shop's ZIP code next to the city in the sync status widget so two branches of the same chain can be told apart.

## Scope
Touch only web/app.js and web/styles.css. Do not change any API response fields.

## Acceptance criteria
- The widget renders a ZIP column for every location that has postal_code.
- A location without postal_code renders an em dash, never a made-up value.

## Tests required
Extend tests/test_web_ui.py; the full suite must stay green.

## Constraints
No Google calls, no publish, no dependency changes, no database migration.

issues.title: Add a regression test for redaction of cookie headers
issues.body:
## Goal
Cover the cookie-header redaction path with a bounded-match regression test so it cannot silently start eating the rest of the log line again.

## Scope
tests/ only; add one new test module, do not touch src/gbp/security/.

## Acceptance criteria
- A log line with a cookie header keeps the text that follows the redacted value.
- A line with no cookie header is unchanged.

## Tests required
New module tests/test_cookie_redaction.py plus the full suite.

## Constraints
No source change; if a source fix looks necessary, stop and report instead.
